label: Derived the universal founding bridge from four typed premises over an agency vocabulary
summary: Derived the universal founding bridge from four typed premises over an agency vocabulary (attestation by the resurrection, divine veracity applied to confirmation, the mandate's scope over Jesus' founding with a teaching commission, envoy founding, restricted to Jesus as envoy). The society-universal is carried by the scope premise, not derived. Omission models show each premise necessary; a joint model shows the premises and every stage antecedent satisfiable. Newly pinned Acts 17 and John 13; the attestation premise is read from Acts 17.31, Matthew 28.18-20, John 13.20 and Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 1 support the other three. All four premises remain open; the scope premise's universal reach over societies and the eleven-to-society map are unsourced. The bare bridge leaves the frontier; route costs rise by 3. Not established: the bridge's truth, any premise, or historical fidelity. Definition audit (2026-11-06): explicit direct-only and Jesus-envoy-inclusive calibration propositions now separate a stipulated word sense from the primitive target predicate. Named-only coverage is open; excluded middle gives I or E or neither, without eliminating either named reading. Five schema interpretations witness overlap, each named reading alone, and neither with the old envoy bridge true or false. Minimal direct calibration does not itself refute the bridge: on that reading the bridge holds exactly when each commissioned Jesus-envoy founding is also direct. The stronger Jesus-scope exclusion plus a nonempty commissioned event does refute it; no Jesus/God distinctness or all-creature exclusion was derived. The event follows from the existing stage antecedents plus attestation, veracity and universal mandate scope. The bridge formula itself never required HoldsMandate. No source claim or frozen Challenge changed. The new conditional routes add three bare framework inputs and do not discharge a root premise. Strength audit (2026-11-06): the Catholic-only scope still includes teaching; its weakness concerns society range. A new nonempty two-society countermodel keeps attestation, veracity, the weak scope and envoy transfer but rejects the universal bridge, fixing an insufficiency not witnessed by the original twoSocietySig (whose teaching-founding field was everywhere true). Stage6 fails in the countermodel; the existing weak-plus-stage6 composition is preserved and already recovers universal scope on the root graph. This audit adds no philosophical premise, root route or actual-world refutation. Export-scope self-sweep after review of related controls: the coarse Task9 target certifies nonempty global stage antecedents but does not itself identify the Catholic founded body or a distinct second body, even though its construction has both. Preserved that frozen Challenge/type and narrowed its prose. New ExplicitBodiesScopeCountermodel exports actual Catholic founding/visibility, a distinct actually founded/visible body, the same God mandate and failure of divine teaching-founding at that pair, plus all four weakened inputs and universal bridge/scope/stage6 failure. Thus the Catholic-only premise is demonstrably nonvacuous in the certified countercase. Declaration completion 2026-11-09: ImmediateCreatureExclusion.ImmediateWithoutCreature encodes the full pointwise own-act requirement and exclusion of all creature or mandate-holder constitutive suppliers. Signature and Challenges unchanged. jointControl has an actual God/direct founding and creatures; fragmentInsufficient separates the old Jesus-only calibration/exclusion from full exclusion. No Jesus creaturehood/divinity or FoundedInMandate-to-SuppliesAct identification is inferred. Exact next gap: a separately stated calibration relating full criterion to FoundedAsTeachingAuthority, and an explicit act-supply bridge if comparing the Jesus event. Historical applicability remains open. This declaration completion adds no corpus consequence or premise truth.
